notes.title: Update V2.0.3
notes.notes: [p]Huge thanks for all the support as always, I am working on trying to make the current game the best it can be before starting on the main roadmap.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Below are the full update notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sparks fix for landing after jumps in Koi Speedpark[/p][/*][*][p]Zoom selection now saves/loads when needed[/p][/*][*][p]Custom controls now save[/p][/*][*][p]Player can no longer turn while jumping[/p][/*][*][p]Exhaust smoke added[/p][/*][*][p]Paint bucket now shows correctly when unlocked in the Unlockable menu[/p][/*][*][p]Add new effects and debris into the Power races[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix for red car stopping randomly[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed of missiles[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix for CPU1 yellow on Monzarella[/p][/*][*][p]Trees can be destroyed with rockets at Monzarella[/p][/*][*][p]More item pads added to all tracks for Power Racing mode[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More updates coming soon ːsteamthumbsupː[/p]

notes.title: Demo update V2.02
notes.notes: [p]Thanks for all the great feedback so far, I have ironed out some bugs and added improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Full list of changes below:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fix for 1st place when 5th[/p][/*][*][p]Tweening added[/p][/*][*][p]Funky 3D backdrops added[/p][/*][*][p]Much improved car select screen[/p][/*][*][p]If game is set to controller, but player presses a keyboard key it will now revert to keyboard controls[/p][/*][*][p]When using keyboard A and D now steers left and right as well as the arrow keys[/p][/*][*][p]If player sets accel to W key this will automatically set proceed button on menus to Enter[/p][/*][*][p]If player sets brake to S key this will set back button on menus to Esc[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now select Up Arrow for accel and Down for Brake, menus will change to Enter and Esc if this happens[/p][/*][*][p]Oil slick fix for Koi Speedpark[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949261/575b63f5ed15ae43dd797b6b39e31cda4790252b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
